figureAlts.figure1.gif: A histogram titled "Histogram of Happiness Scores" displays the distribution of happiness scores from the World Happiness Report study. The x-axis is labeled "Happiness Score" and ranges from 2.8 to 8. The y-axis is labeled "Percent per unit" and ranges from 0 to 40. The histogram shows varying bar heights, with notable peaks around scores 4.5 and 6.5. The code used to generate the histogram is shown as: happiness.hist("Score", bins = np.arange(2.8, 8, 0.5)). A note mentions that the histogram may look different from usual to make bar heights easier to interpret.
